biography.value: Void Motes are the smallest coherent expressions of Space-between-planes existence that can be called through a summoning. They are not intelligent in any useful sense — they have imperatives but not goals, responses but not reasoning. Their value in combat is almost entirely as a nuisance multiplier: individually they deal negligible damage and their skill check penalty is minor. Three of them around a single target simultaneously, applying Swarm Cohesion to their ### Attacks and stacking the skill check penalty, becomes a meaningful debuff. A summoner who calls a Void Mote expecting a combat asset will be disappointed. One who calls several and directs them to swarm a single high-priority caster or skillful opponent will find the cumulative reality disruption degrades that opponent's effectiveness across the encounter.

system.attacksNotes:
Reality Nibble [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 1), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 3 damage (2 + 1 Str); target's next skill check adds 1 to the Skill Die.
  • Margin 2: 3 damage, DR halved (round up); target's next skill check adds 1 to the both Dice; target makes Will [Easy] save or gains the Disoriented condition until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 3 damage, DR halved (round up); target's next skill check has Misfortune. Applies Disoriented condition until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Swarm Cohesion: If 3 or more Void Motes are within 10 feet of the same target, they each subtract 1 from both attack dice. Phase Flicker: When the Void Mote takes damage, it briefly phases between the prime material and the Space between planes, teleporting 1d8 × 5 feet in a random direction as a reaction. Incoherence Field: Opportunity ### Attacks made by Void Motes have Fortune.
